name: Tremor · Checkbox

description.zh: 最后开 Donut Chart。甜甜圈和饼图并排，能切 Code。 Tremor Labs 的 React 图表与仪表盘组件，基于 Tailwind 与 Radix，源码复制进项目。核心仓库 Apache-2.0。Blocks 另售。页顶写 Tremor is joining Vercel。
description.en: Tremor Labs 的 React 图表与仪表盘组件，基于 Tailwind 与 Radix，源码复制进项目。核心仓库 Apache-2.0。Blocks 另售。页顶写 Tremor is joining Vercel。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Tremor (https://www.tremor.so/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, typescript, radix-ui.
Component specification: 最后开 Donut Chart。甜甜圈和饼图并排，能切 Code。
Key visual & interaction patterns: Checkbox、Switch、Dialog.
Visual details from source observation: 我们打开首页，下面已经在跑折线和柱状图。安装页左侧把 Area Chart 到 Tracker 列完。点开 Donut Chart：甜甜圈和饼图并排，能切 Code。适合要仪表盘、不想从空白画起的人。核心复制走 Apache-2.0；Blocks 另售。页顶写加入 Vercel，归属以后可能变。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Core copy-and-paste components are Apache-2.0 and free; Tremor Blocks & Templates are a separate paid catalog
